properties.displayName: QC - D - Detect suspicious process created accessing LSA Secrets
properties.description:
Adversaries with high privilege access to a host may attempt to access Local Security Authority (LSA) secrets, 
which can contain a variety of different credential materials, such as credentials for service accounts.
LSA secrets are stored in the registry at HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SECURITY\Policy\Secrets. 
Advanced adversaries may use the secrets key to assist with extracting passwords and enumerating other sensitive
system information.
Please take in mind that LSA secrets can also be dumped from memory.
References:
- https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1003/004/
- https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0002/
- https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0029/
properties.query:
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(1h)
| where ActionType has "ProcessCreated"
| where InitiatingProcessIntegrityLevel in ("High", "system") 
| where ProcessCommandLine has @"HKLM\security\policy\secrets"
| summarize InitiatingProcessFolderPath = make_set(InitiatingProcessFolderPath), FileName = make_set(FileName), FolderPath = make_set(FolderPath), 
          InitiatingProcessCommandLine = make_set(InitiatingProcessCommandLine),ProcessCommandLine = make_set(ProcessCommandLine), 
          InitiatingProcessParentId = make_set(InitiatingProcessParentId), InitiatingProcessId = make_set(InitiatingProcessId), ProcessId = make_set(ProcessId), 
          count() by DeviceName, ActionType, InitiatingProcessParentFileName, InitiatingProcessFileName, 
                      AccountDomain, AccountName, InitiatingProcessAccountDomain, InitiatingProcessAccountName, 
                      InitiatingProcessIntegrityLevel, ProcessIntegrityLevel
| project-reorder DeviceName, ActionType, count_, 
                  InitiatingProcessParentFileName, InitiatingProcessFolderPath,  InitiatingProcessFileName, FileName, FolderPath, 
                  InitiatingProcessCommandLine, ProcessCommandLine, 
                  InitiatingProcessParentId, InitiatingProcessId, ProcessId,
                  AccountDomain, AccountName, InitiatingProcessAccountDomain, InitiatingProcessAccountName, 
                  InitiatingProcessIntegrityLevel, ProcessIntegrityLevel
